_about: Retailers section of the Hub (owner's option B, 16 Nov 2026, lessons L166). tools/gwh-retailers.mjs turns this file into public/retailers/. The sites of each retailer are in order of how many of its products each site lists (GET of every site's /api/products with retailer= and deliver_to=, 16 Nov 2026); a site with fewer than 20 is left out. Codes and sales are the ones the sites show on their /discount-codes/ pages (GET, UK view, 16 Nov 2026), with their end dates. A banner goes in only after the Manager has checked its picture (no percentages, no previous prices, a code or date that is still valid) and has an end date.
